subject: learning/code-implement-now-repo-root
statement: implement-now resolves default --repo through the pyxis checkout root so debugger and test cwd under cmd/implement-now cannot write .pyxis/logs beside the package.
intent: Keep execution logs in the operand repository even when the process starts in a package directory.
rationale: Go debug and go test use the package directory as cwd. The default --repo was that cwd, so usage errors created stray empty implmentor logs under cmd/implement-now.
fit_criterion: Tests chdir into a nested package path and require resolveRepo(".") to return the ancestor holding .pyxis/config.yaml; usage errors return before creating logs.
